messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great! Now that you've reset the APN settings and rebooted your phone, let's check if MMS is working. Please use the `can_send_mms` action on your phone and tell me what it shows. This will tell us if the messaging app can now send MMS messages after the APN reset and reboot.

I'm sorry, but your messaging app still cannot send MMS messages even after resetting the APN settings and rebooting your phone. I understand this is frustrating. 

Would you like me to check other settings or explore a data refill option to ensure you have enough data to send MMS messages while roaming? Please let me know how you would like to proceed.

Please review the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
